description: Re-enable ZeroAlloc major updates for the root props files.
The shared preset disables ZeroAlloc majors in a root Directory.Packages.props
and Directory.Build.props, which is right for a library keeping its dependency
floors. Here the root files are copies of content/<template>/ that CI's drift
check requires to stay identical, so a major that updates only the template
copies fails the build, as in #433 and #434. The templates always track the
newest ZeroAlloc major, so the root copies must too.
